what: float64 fourth-order operators of deep tanh MLPs u(x) = wo . tanh(W_L ... tanh(W_1 x + b_1) ...) + bo at B points: forward = operator values; vg = 0.5 mean (Op u - f)^2 and its gradient w.r.t. every weight, bias and readout parameter. Candidate = omnibias.jax.experimental.projected_bilaplacian.projected_deep_bilaplacian: per hidden unit its gradient, Hessian, Laplacian, gradient of the Laplacian and bi-Laplacian along k = min(rank, H) columns F with F F^T = W_1 S S^T W_1^T (exact values and parameter gradients) instead of the D input directions or r diffusion columns, with packed symmetric Hessians. Cells with D <= H (aniso: r <= H) are controls where the projection cannot reduce anything. With k0 = D (or r) input directions, Taylor mode runs where k0 <= 2048, omnibias.jax.laplacian with a nested Hessian of its Laplacian where k0 <= 256, and nested autodiff where k0 <= 64
hardware: one NVIDIA A100-SXM4-80GB (exclusive), JAX 0.10.2 with jaxlib 0.10.2 CUDA 12 plugins, CPython 3.12

protocol.repetitions: 3 fresh processes (paired by repetition, rotating method order)
protocol.statistic: ratio = strongest-control median / candidate median per tier; lower95 = exp(mean(log r) - 2.920 sd(log r)/sqrt(3)); strongest control = smallest mean log median among qualified tier members
protocol.qualification: every method's forward and vg programs on a reduced instance (width 4, B = 2, D_q = min(D, 12) > 4 so the projection is active, seed + 1) vs a 50-digit oracle (fourth-order Taylor series along the exact biharmonic quadrature directions of R^D or of the diffusion columns, no projection; objective derivatives along two fixed random parameter directions by central differences in 50 digits): values and objective 1e-9 / 2e-10, directional derivatives 1e-8 / 2e-9 (scaled); full-size outputs finite and digest-checked

status.parity: lower95 < 1 <= ratio or ratio < 1 <= upper bound
status.partial: an applicable tier member failed (e.g. out of memory) or did not qualify; never promoted

protocol.fairness: identical data, initialisation, loss and float64 inputs for every method; compilation excluded (value-and-gradient steady state)

tiers.forward_bilaplacian_full_seed: the same recursion seeded with all D input directions, or the r diffusion columns: per unit gradient, Hessian, Laplacian, gradient of the Laplacian and bi-Laplacian; isolates the projection
tiers.nested_forward_laplacian: folx.forward_laplacian of folx.forward_laplacian on the input; aniso on y -> x + S y
tiers.taylor_mode: fourth-order Taylor mode along the exact biharmonic quadrature directions e_i, e_i +- e_j of R^k, started at the first pre-activation: jax.experimental.jet, and collapsed Taylor mode propagating only the weighted order-4 sum; k <= 2048
tiers.projected_generic_engines: folx2 and collapsed Taylor mode given the candidate's first-layer projection, g(y) = f(W1 x + b1 + F y), k = H; only cells with k > H; isolates the recursion from the projection
tiers.nested_autodiff: jax.hessian trace of omnibias.jax.laplacian.deep_field_value_grad_laplacian, k <= 256; jax.hessian trace of the jax.hessian trace, k <= 64

roles.held_out: cells, operators and seed not used for any tuning
